title: Request camera + microphone permission prompts for Go Live preview (with denial messaging)

requirements.text: Request both camera and microphone permissions as soon as the authenticated user opens the Go Live start form (the "Start a Live Session" card on /live), so the browser shows the combined permission prompts immediately when the local preview mounts.

quotes: Make sure that it gives you the Notification for camera permission microphone And that's it

acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated user clicks "Go Live" (or opens /live?startLive=1) and the start form is shown, the app immediately triggers a single browser permission request that includes both Camera and Microphone access.
The permission request is only triggered for the Go Live preview/start form flow on /live, and does not introduce new permission prompts elsewhere in the app.
If the user closes the start form or navigates away, any active media tracks created for the preview are stopped and the device indicator turns off (no camera/mic left running).

requirements.text: If camera and/or microphone permission is denied for the Go Live preview, show a clear custom error message in the preview area that explicitly mentions camera and microphone permissions and tells the user they can still create a live session without the preview.

quotes: Make sure that it gives you the Notification for camera permission microphone And that's it

acceptanceCriteria: When the user denies either Camera or Microphone permission, the Go Live preview area shows an error state (not a silent failure).

The error message is in English and explicitly references both camera and microphone permissions (example acceptable wording: "Camera or microphone permission denied. You can still create a live session without the preview.").
The existing "local-only preview" explanatory copy remains accurate and is still shown when the preview is successfully running.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Keep the existing backend live-session behavior metadata-only; do not add real-time streaming or backend media ingest as part of this change.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implement real-time livestream video/audio broadcast to viewers.
Add recording, uploading, or storing captured photos/audio from the Go Live preview.
Add permission prompts to non-Live pages or flows.
